[LDET.2.7] **Engine configuration is a precondition of replay, as the
compiled rule set is ([LDET.2.6]).** An integrator configures an engine through
the host interface as well as through the event stream. A setting given through
the host interface is not an event, so the stream does not record it and a
replaying engine does not learn it from the trace ([LFST.9.2.1]).

The integrator must therefore give the replaying engine every setting the
recording engine had that can change an observable in [LDET.2.1]'s output
column. A setting the integrator changed during the run is given again at the
same point, between the same two inputs. A replay against an engine configured otherwise is not a replay of the
recorded run: a divergence it finds is the difference in configuration, not a
determinism failure.

A conforming runtime must state which of its settings can change an observable.
A setting that cannot — one that sizes storage without refusing anything, or
that decides only whether an artefact loads — is not a precondition.
